fields.summary_ko.0: Fortinet (FTNT) is scheduled to report Q3 results on October 28, with revenue guidance of $2.01–2.1B (19.55% YoY growth) and non-GAAP EPS of 83–87 cents.
fields.summary_ko.1: Averaged 20.34% earnings surprise over the past four quarters but no earnings beat is expected this quarter; SASE Firewall demand and AI security business expansion (Virtue AI acquisition) are key growth drivers.
